therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD20 targeting (obinutuzumab/rituximab), antibody-drug conjugate targeting CD79b (polatuzumab vedotin), BCL-2 inhibition (venetoclax)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell depletion, targeted cytotoxic delivery to B-cells, apoptosis induction via BCL-2 inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Complete response (CR) rate at end of induction determined by independent review committee using PET-CT scans

results.effect_size: FL dose expansion: 51.2% CR rate (95% CI: 37.44–64.86); DLBCL dose expansion: 32.5% CR rate (95% CI: 20.41–46.63)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic data showed measurable drug concentrations for all components with expected profiles
subgroup_findings: FL patients showed higher response rates than DLBCL patients
Dose escalation FL cohort achieved 100% CR rate
safety_signals: Cardiac events including heart failure and cardiomyopathy
results.dose_information: RP2D: Polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg, Venetoclax 800 mg, Obinutuzumab 1000 mg (FL) or Rituximab 375 mg/m² (DLBCL), 21-day cycles for 6 cycles

context.duration: 6 cycles of induction (18 weeks) with optional maintenance up to 24 months
